description: This bar chart illustrates the number of sentences, measured in thousands (K), across eight distinct textual categories. The horizontal axis, labeled “Categories,” lists the categories in the following order: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis, labeled “Sentences (K),” is scaled linearly from 0 to 800, with tick marks at intervals of 200. Each bar represents a category and is labeled with its exact value in thousands: Administrative has 525K sentences, Religion has 190K, Fiction has 35K, Law has 23K, News has 902K, Science has 110K, and Blogs has 2K. The bar for Religion is colored light gray, while all other bars are colored light red. The bars are arranged in descending order of sentence count, with “News” being the tallest at 902K and “Blogs” the shortest at 2K. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their height and color, and no additional annotations or legends are present.
